headline: Shoprite CEO Remuneration Plan Faces Opposition from Proxy Advisors
summary: Shoprite's CEO pay plan has encountered resistance from some of the world's largest investors and proxy advisors.
why: Shareholder dissent over executive compensation packages highlights corporate governance tensions and institutional investor scrutiny regarding management incentives.

impacts.name: Shoprite Holdings
impacts.why: Proxy advisor opposition can pressure management to alter executive pay structures.
